infoByStepId.connect_model:
Maestro Studio works with any AI model.

If you already have a subscription to ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini, plug it directly into Maestro Studio.

We also offer an Maestro Studio subscription that gives you the same usage as those providers.

Or use your own API keys.
infoByStepId.enable_actions:
Actions are the capabilities available to your AI agents.

Every tool an agent uses (reading a file, sending an email, searching the web) is an action.

Every action has a permission policy. It decides whether an agent can use it on its own or whether it needs your approval first.

The Actions page is where you turn integrations on, sign in, and tune those permissions.
infoByStepId.launch_agent:
An agent in Maestro Studio can do anything you can do on your computer.

It can read and write files, run commands, search the web, control a browser, send emails, manage your calendar, and handle long, multi step tasks on its own.

Think of each agent as a teammate you can brief on a task and let loose, while you watch it work in real time.
infoByStepId.use_browser:
Maestro Studio has built in browsers so you never have to jump between apps. One place, one workspace, for you and your agents.

The browsers aren't just for you. Your agents can use them too. By default an agent can spin up and use its own browser whenever it needs one.

In the next step we'll see how to hand off a browser you're using to an agent.
infoByStepId.agent_use_browser:
This shows how to give an agent control of a browser already on your canvas. Agents can also spin up their own browsers whenever they need one.

In this demo you handed off a single browser, but you can also hand off multiple browsers at once.

Under the hood, each browser is run by its own specialized agent that talks back to the agent you handed it to.
infoByStepId.agent_control_agents:
Just like browsers, you can pick which agents work together. Or an agent can spin up its own helpers whenever it needs to.

When a task gets too big for one agent, it spins up sub agents to share the load.

When a sub agent finishes, it collapses back into its parent. You can always reopen it from the parent chat by clicking "Reveal in dashboard".
infoByStepId.install_skill:
An agent on its own is a strong general purpose reasoner. It can do a lot, but it doesn't know the specifics of your workflows, your output formats, or your domain.

Skills fill that gap.

A skill is a set of instructions that teach an agent how to handle a specific kind of task. When a skill is active, the agent follows its guidance and produces better, more consistent results in that area.
infoByStepId.make_app:
Apps are interactive, AI generated web applications that live inside Maestro Studio.

Instead of paying for software or spending weeks building a UI, you describe what you want and an agent writes it for you. A live, runnable app appears in seconds.

Once it's made, you can pop the App into your canvas alongside agents and browsers.

signIn.title: Sign in to Maestro Studio
signIn.introMissing: To talk to the Maestro models, this computer needs an access code from your MartinsTech account. It takes three quick steps.
signIn.introExpired: Your Maestro Studio session has expired, which is why the models stopped answering. This happens every 10 hours: just fetch a new code, same three steps.
signIn.step1: Click “Open the sign-in page”. Your browser opens the MartinsTech site.
signIn.step2: Sign in with your usual email and password. The page shows a box with a long piece of text inside: that is your access code.
signIn.step3: Select that whole text, copy it (Ctrl+C), and paste it in the field below.
signIn.pastePlaceholder: Paste the text you copied from the page
signIn.privacy: The code is stored on this computer only. It never shows up in your chats, in error reports, or in anything you share.
signIn.errorExpired: That code has already expired. Go back to the sign-in page, get a new one, and paste it here.
signIn.errorMissing: Paste your access code before continuing.
signIn.errorFailed: We couldn't save the code. Check that you copied the whole text and try again.

warning.message: Your Maestro Studio session ends in {{minutes}} min. Sign in again now so you don't stop mid-task.
